instruction: Navigate to the forms page for the Civil Rights Division on the Department of Justice website.

metadata.explanation: This task variation asks the agent to navigate to the Civil Rights Division forms page on justice.gov. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'forms?title=&field_component_target_id=436' using the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match function. The task maintains the same structure and difficulty as the original Civil Division task, only changing the target division (component ID 436 instead of 431).

llm_judge_reasons: The getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the active tab URL from the Chrome address bar via accessibility tree
The metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify the URL contains the expected query parameters
The expected URL pattern 'forms\?title=&field_component_target_id=436' semantically matches the actual URL structure for the Civil Rights Division (component ID 436) forms page on justice.gov
The evaluator provides complete coverage: checking the URL pattern is sufficient to verify that the user has navigated to the correct forms page for the Civil Rights Division
The data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string → metric receives URL and performs regex matching → returns binary score (1.0 for match, 0.0 for no match)
No timing or state issues: the URL is persistent after navigation and can be verified directly without postconfig
The evaluator logic can correctly distinguish between different division pages (component ID 436 vs other IDs)
